# KELA | Messages from the Trees

> KELA is the original spiritual-reflection work of Tree Medium Patti, published by Lumen Pleroma LLC. The site offers free online animal, tree, and plant oracle cards, nature memory games, and private Tree Medium reading and coaching. Its nature-based oracle experience is distinct from traditional tarot.

## Primary pages

- [Meet Tree Medium Patti](https://treemedium.vercel.app/): Patti's story and a $44 Tree Medium reading. She emails a 5–7 minute private YouTube video within 1–3 business days. The client's first name, last initial, and email address go to Stripe at checkout, and Patti receives them with the payment. There is no phone call.
- [Free Online Oracle Cards](https://treemedium.vercel.app/animal-oracle): Draw a free animal, tree, or plant oracle card online with no signup; an original nature-based alternative to tarot.

## Interactive experiences

- [Free Animal Oracle Card Online](https://treemedium.vercel.app/animal-oracle)
- [Free Tree Oracle Card Online](https://treemedium.vercel.app/tree-oracle)
- [Free Plant Oracle Card Online](https://treemedium.vercel.app/plant-oracle)
- [Free Nature Memory Games](https://treemedium.vercel.app/memory-games)

## Important context

- Each revealed KELA card offers an original interpretation for spiritual reflection and personal growth.
- They do not claim universal, Indigenous, religious, supernatural, or medical authority.
- Oracle content is not a prediction, diagnosis, treatment, or command.
- No plant card is advice to ingest or apply a plant.
- Contact: treemedium@proton.me
